rows.comment: My Son’ is often moving and spare
rows.verdict_le10: My Son’ is often moving and spare
rows.dek_lead: This might all sound melodramatic, but ‘So Long, My Son’ is often moving and spare. It’s a film that pulls you into it as the story moves between the past, present and future, leaving us to work out exactly where we are, in time and place.
